corrected_summary: Florence's Scudo Verde environmental ZTL began in monitoring mode on 1 April 2025 (77 gates, about 38 km2), with sanctions postponed to 1 July 2025; the Comune says it adds no new bans and no toll, and La Nazione reported the Euro 4 exemption and a EUR 1.2 million vehicle incentive fund. The historic-centre ZTL runs summer Thursday-Saturday night closures (23:00-03:00), reinstated on 2 April 2026 across all five sectors. La Nazione's 2023 garage figures show the Santa Maria Novella station garage as the top earner (EUR 3.835 million revenue) with Fortezza and Piazza Alberti loss-making, and in October 2025 the Comune announced a 50% discount at the Alberti garage during piazza Beccaria tram works. Garage tariffs in May 2026 were about EUR 4 an hour at the station.
